help.content: Tray usually refers to a JEDEC standard matrix tray measuring 12.7x5.35 inches and either 0.25 or 0.40 inches tall. Trays are usually constructed from plastic, but aluminum is permissible. JEDEC trays contain slots to allow air to pass vertically and are rated for at least 140°C to allow drying of parts in industrial ovens. Trays are stackable and feature a chamfered corner indicating the orientation of pin one of the parts. Trays are packaged according to the ESD (ElectroStatic Discharge) and MSL (Moisture Sensitivity Level) protection requirements determined by the manufacturer.
